Scope: comparison registry, moved eyesim compatibility methods, template family and recipe codecs, related exports, laws, and migration documentation. Excluded tools/api-audit JSON and .mote/ops. No candidate or main source edits.

Review observations:
- compare/src/main/scala/eyes4s/compare/MapComparison.scala: Map method tokens preserve historical repetition identities. Cosine retains its Kernel and bounded execution; L1 exposes total variation as the Metric and declares the similarity transform.
- compare/src/main/scala/eyes4s/compare/eyesim/EyesimCompat.scala:59 and Distribution.scala:523: the old and new Fisher endpoint formulas remain separate; legacy saved names and tokens are retained. RepetitionPlanCodec uses the compatibility-aware token reader.
- design/src/main/scala/eyes4s/design/Template.scala:431: admission checks precede train.head, exclusions are returned, and fitted evaluation retains keyed failures. Native and imported fixed-feature fitting routes are explicitly separated. Moved fixed-feature and mean-map fitting use the same least-squares implementation and input order.
- codec/src/main/scala/eyes4s/codec/TemplateRecipeCodec.scala:49: old ungrouped fixed-feature and mean-map payloads retain their hashes and schema forms; grouped fixed-feature payloads use the second rung. The pinned earlier-codec fixtures verify decode/re-encode and refitting. Documentation explicitly describes the caller-schema version collision limitation.
- laws/src/test/scala/eyes4s/laws/TemplateRecipeLawSuite.scala and laws/.jvm/src/test/scala/eyes4s/laws/TemplateRecipeFixtureJvmSuite.scala: generated round-trip and ladder laws are cross-platform source, while resource-backed pinned fixture checks are JVM-only. The generator suite was not replaced by fixture-only testing. Registry interface laws include deliberate mutants.

Independent probes: added only in the review snapshot at codec/src/test/scala/eyes4s/codec/CR2ReviewCanonicalWireSuite.scala. All seven ComparisonMethods entries execute a mixed-success/failure study, round-trip typed results, and restore both plans and results through ArtifactDecoders.study. Each restored plan also executes. This test file is not a candidate change.
